persona: Grace, a nonprofit director with no technical skills
plain_request: We need a fast public website for our charity plus a private members area where volunteers log in to see schedules. It must be cheap to run, fast everywhere, and safe for our members' details.
title: static site + CDN + authenticated members area
critical_rationale: The user says 'safe for our members' details' without a vocabulary for it; world-class delivery enforces OWASP ASVS (owasp namespace) on the auth boundary — schema validation, secrets via env — plus accessibility and Web Vitals for the public site.
acceptance_criteria: The public site is served from a CDN and loads fast for visitors anywhere
Volunteers can log into a private members area to view schedules
Member login input is schema-validated and credentials are never stored in source
The public site meets accessibility and Core Web Vitals targets
